rationale.audience_fit: If the room isn't our buyers, nothing else rescues it.
rationale.promotion_allowed: Communities that ban self-promo are listening channels, not marketing ones.
rationale.reach: Size matters only after fit and permission; dead large groups lose to small active ones.
rationale.timing: Launch windows and AMA slots close fast; a missed window kills the opportunity.
rationale.effort_inverse: Bounded effort - worst case is a few weeks of engagement, unlike travel or integrations.
rationale.cost_inverse: Communities are mostly free; cost only matters for paid sponsorships or memberships.
